quality_comparisons.objective_verifier: The deterministic fixture test verifies that high-end-visual-design materializes no derived surface unless a project explicitly enables it, so it cannot become a silent default for any surface including dashboards and B2B UI.
Every dashboard, B2B, settings, data-table, accessibility-first, and regulated control prompt in this fixture is labelled not-trigger, matching the descriptor's declared non-applicability.
